Bihar Teacher Aspirants Threaten Protest Over TRE-4 Notification

Teacher aspirants in Bihar have set a 24-hour deadline for the release of the TRE-4 notification, threatening a sit-in protest at the minister's residence if their demand is not met. Aspirants have been waiting for the notification for the fourth phase of teacher recruitment. Some reports suggest the Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) may issue the advertisement for approximately 32,388 vacancies today, possibly to avert further protests.
